text:
alicia: FYI I'm going to push a schema tweak to runtime-config that adds a `dependent_flags` array to feature flags. Will start a canary at 1% — need checks for routing/quota interactions. PR: https://git.redwood/infer/pulls/4123

ben: what's the migration path? if an old flag is toggled while a dependent flag is off, do we auto-block?

alicia: short answer: validation will block application if dependency not satisfied during canary. Example snippet:
```json
{"name":"enable_fastpath","dependencies":["enable_kv_cache","route_by_cost_enabled"]}
```

maria: console UX ask: we need a dependency graph in the flag drawer and a blocking modal if toggle would violate deps. Also show which customers are affected (cohorts).

ben: telemetry/alerts: can we gate rollout by `config.apply.errors` and `route.latency_p95`? thresholds: errors > 0.5% OR p95 + 30ms -> abort.

alicia: yes. plan: canary 1% (30m), 5% (1h), 25% (2h). Gate checks every 5m. If any gate trips we rollback automatically. Will add a dry-run API `POST /v1/config/preview` that simulates apply and returns impacted routes.

ops-bot: preflight check: schema lint ok, e2e tests passed (svc-config, console) :rocket:

devconsole: added dashboard: https://dash.redwood/boards/flags-deps-canary with panels for `config.apply.errors`, `route.latency_p95`, `quota.fail_rate`. Also added alert `cfg-dep-canary-trip` -> paging ops.

alicia: Ben — we also need sampling keys for quota vs flag changes. If a flag touches quota entries we should run a small traffic replay on reserve capacity.

ben: agree. propose adding `affected_quota_ids` to the preview response and auto-trigger a replay job with `--sample=1%`.

maria: audit: every preview and apply should create an audit row with `actor`, `preview_id`, `affected_entities`. Console needs to surface the last preview id on the toggle page.

alicia: assigning UI work to @maria, preview API to @ben, replay infra to @frank. I'll own rollout orchestration and gating.

frank: quick check: SRE safety net is fine but we need `config.apply.errors` emitted by the deployment agent (not just console). Will add to SLOs and a short-term alert window.

maria: noted, will add a small UX copy for blocking modal explaining "this flag depends on X — contact owner" :memo:

ben: quick test command for preview: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/config/preview -d '{"flag":"enable_fastpath","target":"5%"}'`

alicia: thanks all. I'll start canary at 18:05 UTC. ping me if you see anything weird. :thumbsup:

frank: :+1:
